description.value: Blue Water Cafe + raw bar is a landmark seafood restaurant in the heart of Yaletown, celebrating 25 years of operation with a raw bar showcasing daily-rotating oysters, Dungeness crab, and chilled seafood prepared by Executive Chef Frank Pabst and Sushi Chef Masaaki Kudo. The restaurant offers both indoor dining and a garden patio with a retractable awning, situated in one of Vancouver's most cycling-accessible waterfront neighbourhoods.
